meta.pricingPolicy: Every two-adult price below is computed strictly from explicit menu/booking prices published on the restaurant's own official site or official Tock/Resy page checked on 2026-11-25. Menu subtotals exclude NYC 8.875% sales tax, beverages, supplements, and discretionary gratuity unless explicitly stated (e.g., Atomix administrative fee included, no gratuity accepted). Where a restaurant does not publish exact prices on an accessible official page, the 2-adult total is left blank and flagged.
